# IItems.Happened event

Raised on the game's thread when something happens with an item ([`ItemMoment`](../ItemMoment.md)). Every game raises it for every runner it simulates, and each moment says whether this game decides it ([`IsDecidedHere`](../ItemMomentEventArgs/IsDecidedHere.md)).
